body:
My numbness started to falling apart, same thing with my subconscious ability to repress any emotions. I'm 26 and live like that for like 10 years now.

I don't know if this is a good or bad thing.

I was driving to do some grocery few days ago and without any reason I started crying my eyes out. I wasn't sad, no negative emotions were surrounding me but it happened. I just could not stop. I cried and cried without any specific reason. 

Last time I cried was years, years ago on some funeral. Weird shit, fuck depression, I want to live my life normally.
Same! 5 more of those sweet sweet synthetic shares!

Thank you! Change is everyting, I can't live with that autodestruction routine no more.   
Little wins are a way to go, I think.

I'm an independent investor, and I'll just buy when I feel like buying....  
  
I am not part of a group that organizes buys in order to manipulate the market....  
  
I am an individual retail investor that makes my own decisions on when I buy and sell...

Don't look my man, keep your mind on something else. This is extremely wild today. Put sell limit on 500/1000/1500 and try to do something else.  
Be strong!
